purpose: Bounded FD/FP diagnostic and optimization pilot; preserve immutable baseline
scope: Post-hoc non-blind optimization; historical test results and failure modes already known. No new collection or blind generalization claim.
numeric_mode: Exclude Ready and explicit missingness features; training-median imputation can still encode missingness indirectly.
state_mode: Ready summaries and all observed masks only; FP contains only observed-mask summaries.

FD_fit_regimes.supervised: all eligible D01-D04 windows including injected positives; changed supervision regime, not a like-for-like unsupervised replacement

FP_fit_scope: original eligible D01-D04 clean-history index; 54572 windows
scaling: reuse frozen baseline train-only preprocessor for each task
selection: Within each task and supervision regime, maximize D05 event recall at 0.1/h, then lower actual FAR, then higher AUPRC, then lexicographic name; state control not eligible as numeric-main winner. Preserve state control as separate result.
followup_fits: Refit selected supervised winner with seeds29/43; refit matched state control with seeds29/43. No new hyperparameter search after evaluation.
constraints: unchanged labels, eligibility, event matching, FAR denominators
no claims that new training seeds are physical repeats
